title: detect_pockets finds no slot on a straight slot open at both ends (through-holes on its floor)

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: area:mcp
labels.description: MCP server and agent tooling (crates/app/src/mcp, camcraft-mcp skill)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
## What happens

`detect_pockets {model: "flange"}` returns `{"count": 0, "features": []}` on a part with a straight 10 mm wide x 3 mm deep slot that runs across the whole +X end of the plate (open at both ends, flat floor at z 7). The tool's description says it recognises "straight slots with open, round or square ends". Two of the part's through-holes start on the slot floor, which may be what throws the recogniser off.

## Expected

One feature: a straight slot, width 10, floor z 7, top z 10, both ends open, centreline x = 40 from y -30 to 30 (or a refusal note naming why it was not recognised).

## Repro (MCP, upstream main abe24ff09)

**Part (p01-flange):** 6061 plate 100 x 60 x 10 mm centred on the origin (z 0..10), a 60 x 30 x 5 mm island on top (z 10..15, R5 corners) with a 1 x 45 deg chamfer on its top edges, 4 x dia 6 through holes at (+-42, +-22), a 10 mm wide x 3 mm deep slot across the +X end (x 35..45, floor z 7). Stock: box fitted to the model with +2 mm on top (100 x 60 x 17, z 0..17). WCS G54 at the stock's min-X min-Y top corner, world (-50, -30, 17). Machine Tormach 770MX, post Tormach PathPilot.

`detect_pockets {model: "flange"}` -> `{"count": 0, "features": [], "frame": "world", "model": "flange"}`.

Workaround: a manual `Slot` with `a: [40, -36], b: [40, 36], width: 10` - it posts clean.

Found by the QA swarm (SolidCraft v0.44.1 + CamCraft v0.23.0, part p01-flange). Re-checked on upstream main abe24ff09.

**Done means:** this slot (open at both ends, holes through its floor) is listed by `detect_pockets` with its width, floor, top and open ends, and `create` makes a Slot that posts; a test pins it, plus one without the holes.
